can_execute.note: No sentence on the pages read says the product launches or publishes ads, and none says a human must. The site talks about downloading ('A credit is used when you download a generated ad creative.') and 'ready-to-launch' output, and it connects ad accounts for analysis only.

multi_agent.note: No agent wording on the pages read.

evidence.quote: Integrations allow you to connect your ad accounts to your brands on AdCreative.ai.
AdCreative.ai integrates with all major file management systems like Google Drive and OneDrive

integrations.note: 'Linkedin Ads' is spelled as on the site. 'Unlimited Photos by iStock' is a plan feature and is left out.

pricing.note: Pricing is a section of the homepage with three billing toggles. Starter plan: '$39' monthly, '$29' quarterly, '$20' yearly; the per-period unit was not captured in the reading, and a sale banner was running ('50% off yearly, 25% off quarterly plans!'). The page is internally inconsistent on the Ultimate price ($599 and $999). free_tier is true because of a trial, not a free plan.

hq_location.quote: Mail: 40 RUE DES BLANCS MANTEAUX 75004 PARIS
hq_location.note: A mailing address on the terms page (contracting entity 'ADYOUNEED SAS and/or any of its affiliates'); the word France does not appear on that page, so the country is derived from 'PARIS' and the postcode. Confirmed on a second read. No address on the homepage or enterprise page.

hq_external.quote: AdCreative.ai, based in Paris, France, is a leading AI-driven platform

notes: The homepage is very long (about 102,000 characters of text; the reading tool stopped at 100,000, so the footer was cut). Positioned as an AI ad-creative generator rather than an agent. Owned by Appier per the terms page and the press release used for hq_external.
